35098-sonnets-and-songs.title: And Songs
35098-sonnets-and-songs.creator: Helen Hay Whitney
35098-sonnets-and-songs.description: A book by Helen Hay Whitney. In this new symmetry you have no part,  No lot in my fair life. The stars still chime  Autumn and Spring in ceaseless pantomime. I play with Beauty, which is kin to Art,  Forgetting Nature. Nor do pulses start  To hear your soul remembered in a rhyme.

35873-henry-martyn-saint-and-scholar-fir.title: First Modern Missionary To The Mohammedans 1781-1812
35873-henry-martyn-saint-and-scholar-fir.creator: George Smith, C.I.E., Ll.D.
35873-henry-martyn-saint-and-scholar-fir.description: A book by George Smith, C.I.E., Ll.D.. Then came another of priestly garb and mien, A young man still wanting the years of Christ, But long since with the saints.... A poet with the contemplative gaze And listening ear, but quick of force and eye, Who fought the wrong without, the wrong within, And, being a pure saint, like those of old, Abased himself and all the precious gifts God gave him, flinging all before the feet Of Him whose name he bore--a fragile form Upon whose hectic cheek there

72374-the-emperor-s-candlesticks.title: Candlesticks
72374-the-emperor-s-candlesticks.creator: The Baroness Emmuska Orczy
72374-the-emperor-s-candlesticks.description: A book by The Baroness Emmuska Orczy. What young man is there, be he prince or peasant, who would have allowed so mocking a game to be carried on at his expense. Nicholas Alexandrovitch, son and heir of the Tsar of all the Russias, remembered only that he was twenty years of age, that he had come to the opera ball, accompanied by that dry old stick Lavrovski, with the sole purpose of enjoying himself incognito for once, and… he started in hot pursuit.

75812-an-outlaw-s-diary-the-commune.title: The Commune
75812-an-outlaw-s-diary-the-commune.creator: Cecile Tormay
75812-an-outlaw-s-diary-the-commune.description: A book by Cecile Tormay. The neighbouring streets repeat the cry. A drawn shutter rattles violently in the dark. Street doors bang as they are hurriedly closed. Running steps clatter past the houses, accompanied by two sounds: “Long live ... Death....” The latter is meant for us. Shots ring out at the street corner.

arxiv-2206-08636.title: Dynamics of a dispersively coupled transmon qubit in the presence of a noise source embedded in the control line
arxiv-2206-08636.creator: Antti Vaaranta, Marco Cattaneo, Russell E. Lake
arxiv-2206-08636.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Antti Vaaranta, Marco Cattaneo, Russell E. Lake. We describe transmon qubit dynamics in the presence of noise introduced by an impedance-matched resistor ( 50 ​ Ω 50\,\mathrm{\Omega} ) that is embedded in the qubit control line. To obtain the time evolution, we rigorously derive the circuit Hamiltonian of the qubit, readout resonator and resistor by describing the latter as an infinite collection of bosonic modes through the Caldeira-Leggett model.

arxiv-2211-06111.title: Self-organized bistability on scale-free networks
arxiv-2211-06111.creator: Nikita Frolov 1,2, Alexander Hramov 1,2
arxiv-2211-06111.description: Abstract A dynamical system approaching the first-order transition can exhibit a specific type of critical behavior known as self-organized bistability (SOB). It lies in the fact that the system can permanently switch between the coexisting states under the self-tuning of a control parameter.

arxiv-2302-13879.title: The Spectrum of Low- p T p_{T} J / ψ J/\psi in Heavy-Ion Collisions in a Statistical Two-Body Fractal Model
arxiv-2302-13879.creator: Huiqiang Ding, Luan Cheng *, Tingting Dai, Enke Wang, Wei-Ning Zhang
arxiv-2302-13879.description: Abstract We establish a statistical two-body fractal (STF) model to study the spectrum of J / ψ J/\psi . J / ψ J/\psi serves as a reliable probe in heavy-ion collisions. The distribution of J / ψ J/\psi in hadron gas is influenced by flow, quantum and strong interaction effects.

arxiv-2305-12721.title: Enhancement of density of states and suppression of superconductivity in site-disordered topological metal LaPtSi
arxiv-2305-12721.creator: Sitaram Ramakrishnan, Tatsuya Yamakawa, Ryohei Oishi, Yasuyuki Shimura, Takahiro Onimaru, Arumugam Thamizhavel, Srinivasan Ramakrishnan, Minoru Nohara
arxiv-2305-12721.description: Abstract Single crystals of non-centrosymmetric s s -wave superconductor LaPt 0.88 Si 1.12 have been grown by the Czochralski (Cz) technique, whose crystal structure is described by the space group I ​ 4 ​ m 1 ​ d I4{{}_{1}}md at ambient conditions.

arxiv-2307-11278.title: Generator-Retriever-Generator Approach for Open-Domain Question Answering DOI: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.11278 Conference: arxiv; March 2024; arxiv arxiv
arxiv-2307-11278.creator: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Adam Jatowt
arxiv-2307-11278.description: Abstract . Open-domain question answering (QA) tasks usually require the retrieval of relevant information from a large corpus to generate accurate answers. We propose a novel approach called Generator-Retriever-Generator (GRG) that combines document retrieval techniques with a large language model (LLM), by first prompting the model to generate contextual documents based on a given question.

arxiv-2404-09305.title: OWLOOP: Interfaces for Mapping OWL Axioms into OOP Hierarchies ⋆ \,\star † † footnotetext: ⋆ \;\star This manuscript details the implementation of the OWLOOP API. A simplified (and citable ) presentation of our API has been published in the SoftwareX Elsevier journal with the title “OWLOOP: A modula
arxiv-2404-09305.creator: \sn Luca \gn Buoncompagni and \sn Fulvio \gn Mastrogiovanni
arxiv-2404-09305.description: Abstract The paper tackles the issue of mapping logic axioms formalised in the Ontology Web Language (OWL) within the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigm. The issues of mapping OWL axioms hierarchies and OOP objects hierarchies are due to OWL-based reasoning algorithms, which might change an OWL hierarchy at runtime; instead, OOP hierarchies are usually defined as static structures.

arxiv-2406-09897.title: 3D-RPE: Enhancing Long-Context Modeling Through 3D Rotary Position Encoding
arxiv-2406-09897.creator: Xindian Ma, Wenyuan Liu, Peng Zhang, Nan Xu
arxiv-2406-09897.description: Abstract Inspired by the Bloch Sphere representation, we propose a novel rotary position encoding on a three-dimensional sphere, named 3D Rotary Position Encoding (3D-RPE). 3D-RPE is an advanced version of the widely used 2D Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE), with two major advantages for modeling long contexts: controllable long-term decay and improved position resolution.

arxiv-2501-11616.title: Fully Adaptive Zeroth-Order Method for Minimizing Functions with Compressible Gradients Thanks: G. N. Grapiglia was partially supported by FRS-FNRS, Belgium (Grant CDR J.0081.23).
arxiv-2501-11616.creator: Geovani N. Grapiglia, Daniel McKenzie
arxiv-2501-11616.description: Abstract We propose an adaptive zeroth-order method for minimizing differentiable functions with L L -Lipschitz continuous gradients. The method is designed to take advantage of the eventual compressibility of the gradient of the objective function, but it does not require knowledge of the approximate sparsity level s s or the Lipschitz constant L L of the gradient.

arxiv-2502-05311.title: ParquetDB: A Lightweight Python Parquet-Based Database
arxiv-2502-05311.creator: Logan Lang, Eduardo Hernandez, Kamal Choudhary, Aldo H. Romero
arxiv-2502-05311.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Logan Lang, Eduardo Hernandez, Kamal Choudhary, Aldo H. Romero. Traditional data storage formats and databases often introduce complexities and inefficiencies that hinder rapid iteration and adaptability. To address these challenges, we introduce ParquetDB, a Python-based database framework that leverages the Parquet file format’s optimized columnar storage. ParquetDB offers efficient serialization and deserialization, native support for complex and nested data types, reduced dependency on indexing through predicate pushdown filtering, and enhanced portability due to its file-based storage system.

arxiv-2512-12024.title: Hyper model checking for high-level relational models CCS: Software and its engineering Model checking CCS: Security and privacy Logic and verification CCS: Software and its engineering Specification languages
arxiv-2512-12024.creator: Nuno Macedo, Hugo Pacheco
arxiv-2512-12024.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nuno Macedo, Hugo Pacheco. Many properties related to security or concurrency must be encoded as so-called hyperproperties, temporal properties that allow reasoning about multiple traces of a system. However, despite recent advances on model checking hyperproperties, there is still a lack of higher-level specification languages that can effectively support software engineering practitioners in verifying properties of this class at early stages of system design.

arxiv-2601-13262.title: CURE-Med: Curriculum-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Medical Reasoning
arxiv-2601-13262.creator: Eric OnyameUniversity of VirginiaAkash GhoshIIT-PatnaSubhadip BaidyaIIT-PatnaSriparna SahaIIT-PatnaXiuying ChenMBZUAIChirag AgarwalUniversity of Virginia
arxiv-2601-13262.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Eric OnyameUniversity of VirginiaAkash GhoshIIT-PatnaSubhadip BaidyaIIT-PatnaSriparna SahaIIT-PatnaXiuying ChenMBZUAIChirag AgarwalUniversity of Virginia. While large language models (LLMs) have shown to perform well on monolingual mathematical and commonsense reasoning, they remain unreliable for multilingual medical reasoning applications, hindering their deployment in multilingual healthcare settings. We address this by first introducing CureMed-Bench , a high-quality multilingual medical reasoning dataset with open-ended reasoning queries with a single verifiable answer, spanning thirteen languages, including underrepresented languages such as Amharic, Yoruba, and Swahili.

pmc-10712195.title: Prevention and treatment of osteoporosis with natural products: Regulatory mechanism based on cell ferroptosis
pmc-10712195.creator: Yunshang Yang, Yifan Jiang, Daoyi Qian, Zhirong Wang, Long Xiao
pmc-10712195.description: ContextWith the development of society, the number of patients with osteoporosis is increasing. The prevention and control of osteoporosis has become a serious and urgent issue. With the continuous progress of biomedical research, ferroptosis has attracted increased attention. However, the pathophysiology and mechanisms of ferroptosis and osteoporosis still need further study.

pmc-11386380.title: An analysis of cause-specific under-5 mortality in Bangladesh using the demographic and health survey 2011 and 2017–2018
pmc-11386380.creator: Tapas Mazumder, Itismita Mohanty, Danish Ahmad, Theo Niyonsenga
pmc-11386380.description: BackgroundAs the Sustainable Development Goal 3.2.1 deadline (2030) approaches, rapidly reducing under-5 mortality (U5M) gains more prominence. However, initiatives or interventions that aided Bangladesh in achieving Millennium Development Goal 4 showed varied effectiveness in reducing certain cause-specific U5M. Therefore, this study aimed to examine the predictors of the key cause-specific mortalities.

pmc-11669591.title: The impact of sleep disorders on brain network connectivity in postpartum women: a functional near-infrared spectroscopy-based study
pmc-11669591.creator: Xia Chen, Shanguang Zhao, Danni Chen, Dan Zhang
pmc-11669591.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sleep disorder is an important risk factor for postpartum depression. Although previous research has explored brain activity in postpartum depression, it has not fully revealed how insomnia affect mood by altering interactions between brain regions. This study aim to investigate the relationship between insomnia and depressive status in postpartum women, utilizing functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to explore brain network topological properties. Among 143 postpartum women, 40 were diagnosed with insomnia and 103 without.

pmc-12682083.title: Ocular surface characteristics and its association with soft contact lens fitting
pmc-12682083.creator: Javier Rojas Viñuela, James S. Wolffsohn, Alejandra Consejo, Eef van der Worp, David P. Piñero
pmc-12682083.description: PurposeTo analyse the associations between ocular surface shape parameters and soft contact lens fitting.MethodsA total of 106 eyes of 53 participants (53 right and 53 left eyes) fitted with standard silicone hydrogel soft lenses were analysed retrospectively. The sagittal height of the lenses was obtained from an independent publication.

pmc-13111296.title: Association between serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D, nutritional status, and inflammatory markers in sepsis patients with and without sarcopenia
pmc-13111296.creator: Hong Zheng, Chaoyong Bei, Zhongcheng Mo, Bing Wei
pmc-13111296.description: BackgroundSepsis, a critical infectious syndrome, frequently presents with sarcopenia and is typified by an inflammatory cascade and vitamin D (VD) deficiency. The interrelation between these conditions remains to be fully elucidated. VD, known for its immunomodulatory properties, is suspected to play a role in the pathogenesis of both sepsis and sarcopenia.

pmc-13250629.title: High Adherence to Pharmacological Treatment Guidelines in Recovery and Remission States Among Patients With Schizophrenia: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13250629.creator: Ryo Asada, Hitoshi Iida, Leo Gotoh, Kiyohiro Yasumatsu, Hikaru Hori
pmc-13250629.description: BackgroundSeveral schizophrenia guidelines have been published, showing treatment efficacy. However, no studies have examined recovery and pharmacological therapy or guideline adherence's impact on various schizophrenia states. This study aimed to investigate adherence to pharmacological guidelines across recovery, remission, and non‐remission states in patients with schizophrenia.

pmc-13282819.title: Immune Profiling Identifies Inflammatory Signatures in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor–Related Myocarditis
pmc-13282819.creator: Douglas Daoudlarian, Sarah Boughdad, Robin Bartolini, Sofiya Latifyan, Jacqueline Doms, Hasna Bouchaab, Karim Abdelhamid, Nabila Ferahta, Nuria Neisy Mederos Alfonso, Victor Joo, Antonia Stamatiou, Lucrezia Mencarelli, Nicolas Etienne, Athina Stravodimou, Khalil Zaman, Matthieu Perreau, Craig Fenwic
pmc-13282819.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitor–associated myocarditis (ICI-My) is rare but potentially life-threatening. Biomarkers that distinguish myocarditis-related inflammation from background immune activation induced by ICIs remain needed.ObjectivesThis study sought to define the circulating inflammatory and cellular immune landscape of ICI-My, relate these findings to clinical severity, and explore the feasibility of interleukin-6 receptor (IL-6R) blockade in selected steroid-refractory cases.

pmc-13290434.title: Harnessing Gut Microbiota to Enhance Immunotherapy in NSCLC: From Mechanisms to Translational Applications
pmc-13290434.creator: Liming Zhu, Jiayao Xu, Dong Niu, Xiangyu Zhang, Chunhui Jin
pmc-13290434.description: The gut microbiome has emerged as a pivotal regulator of immunotherapy efficacy in non‐small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with mounting evidence demonstrating that microbial‐immune crosstalk significantly influences therapeutic responses. Current research reveals that commensal bacteria modulate host immunity through complex metabolic and immunological pathways, yet the precise mechanisms underlying these interactions remain incompletely characterized.
